outcome: Length of stay in health facilities after childbirth
cohort: 2260 mothers who participated in the 2016 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Gestational age and mode of delivery were significantly associated with length of stay in health facilities after childbirth in Ethiopian mothers.
mod_finding: Mothers who had a vaginal delivery were 8.89% more likely to be discharged earlier from health facilities after delivery, compared with those who had a caesarian section.
